description: Land Acquisition - Iyakkachchi, Panchchilaipali D/S Division, Kilinochchi District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (lots A-D) with their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando) issuing the order, the core content focuses on the legal process of taking possession of land properties, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
